conditional_candidate_rule: If head_tail does not improve both validation Macro-F1 and Clear Reply recall over head, fit head_inverse_frequency. Only class weighting changes for this comparison.
head_tail_budget: After accounting for the intact question and the three pair special tokens, take ceil(available_answer_tokens/2) from the prefix and floor(available_answer_tokens/2) from the suffix. An answer already inside its budget is unchanged.
selection_rule: Select the maximum validation Macro-F1 across completed options, breaking exact ties by the order listed above; select the earliest epoch for an exact epoch tie. Evaluate the selected option once on the fixed test after all validation decisions.
